review_kind: basic single-asset likeness and volume gate; not final scene acceptance

pilot_tree.reason: Evergreen silhouette and branching fit the forest edge; front and reverse rendered in Godot show volumetric geometry, not a whole-object billboard.
pilot_tree.limitations: Color too pale under current lighting; still needs density and performance tuning.

pilot_shrub.reason: Mixed leafy low vegetation resembles concept vegetation at a basic level and keeps volumetric geometry in front and reverse views.
pilot_shrub.limitations: Leaves appear noisy and some tiny flowers are lost; needs complementary distinct flowers and ferns.

pilot_slab.reason: Second candidate has a flatter rectangular worn stone surface and engraved glyphs close to the reference.
pilot_slab.limitations: Needs color matching and a varied modular set; trial replacement is not final road construction.

scene_limitations: Vegetation density and color differ from concept
